amem.note: Official AgenticMemorySystem add_note/search_agentic path; one HABIT-Bench session is one note.

full_history.note: Recent full-history window bounded by the Qwen3-8B context limit; not a learned memory method.

graphiti.note: Official add_episode/search_ APIs with a local Kuzu backend and edge-cosine retrieval because Kuzu BM25 is unavailable.

mem0.note: Official Memory.add(infer=True) and Memory.search APIs without benchmark-specific extraction instructions; Qwen3 thinking is disabled through the OpenAI request body.

medmemorybench_amem.note: MedMemoryBench vendored A-MEM source via add_note/find_related_memories; retrieval-only output is passed to the shared HABIT answerer.

medmemorybench_letta.note: MedMemoryBench vendored Letta source; archival passage vector search is exposed without a Letta answer turn.

medmemorybench_lightmem.note: MedMemoryBench LightMem source; native retrieve output is passed to the shared HABIT answerer.

medmemorybench_mem0.note: MedMemoryBench vendored Mem0 source via Memory.add/Memory.search; no external mem0ai package or method-specific answer call.

medmemorybench_memos.note: MedMemoryBench MemOS source; native text-memory search is exposed without reader generation.

medmemorybench_memrl.note: MedMemoryBench MemRL source; value-aware selected memories are exposed without reader generation.

medmemorybench_mirix.note: MedMemoryBench MIRIX source; multi-store retrieval is exposed without native send_message answering.

no_memory.note: Qwen3-8B receives only the current request and choices; not a learned memory method.

omem.note: Official SimpleMemory lifecycle with documented JSON-output compatibility patches for the local OpenAI-compatible backend.

secom.note: Official segmentation, compression, and retrieval modules adapted to chronological per-session ingestion.
